Request a Consultation Memberships Financing Gift Cards Skincare Products Request a Consultation Request a Consultation Back Ann Marie Connor, LE Master Esthetician Locations: Dover Ann Marie brings over two decades of expertise in skin therapy and nail technology to the Skin Health Medi Spa team. Born and raised in New Hampshire, she holds a bachelor’s degree in psychology from Keene State College and an associate’s degree in criminal justice from New Hampshire Technical Institute. A licensed skin therapist and nail tech since 2003, Ann Marie is also a Reiki Master with ten years of practice. She spent a decade teaching at local aesthetic schools and served as a regional educator for Dermalogica for eight years. Whether she’s walking the beach or boating, her love of the water keeps her grounded and inspired.
